_comment: Android overlay for scripts/gen_player_android_cmake.py. The Android Player source set is the Windows Player set (Studio vcxproj + scripts/player_include_manifest.json) MINUS android_exclude, PLUS android_stubs. Paths are relative to RayTrophiStudio/source (globs use fnmatch on the 'src/...' form). Everything Android-specific lives here as data; the generator hardcodes none of it.
_comment_android_exclude: Operator/kiosk layer + camera-perception bridge (Windows-only, out of scope for the touch build), the TLS remote IPC transport (Winsock+OpenSSL server), the DirectXTex BC compressor, and legacy OpenVDB simulation and volume I/O. Every excluded file whose symbols are still referenced by kept files has a stub below.
_comment_exception_sources: Vec3SIMD::get throws on an invalid lane index.
_comment_cxx_flags_per_abi: The x86_64 emulator uses native AVX2/FMA. Jolt derives JPH_USE_LZCNT/TZCNT/F16C from __AVX2__, so -mf16c -mlzcnt -mbmi must accompany -mavx2 (MSVC needs no per-feature flags). AArch64 uses SIMDe through Math/SimdIntrin.h.

deps.note: SDL2 source tree (contains CMakeLists.txt and android-project/). Built as libSDL2.so by this CMake via add_subdirectory.
SDL2_image source tree (PNG/JPG). Needs RT_SDL2_DIR first.

_comment_include_dirs: Dirs the Windows build gets from VC++ <IncludePath> or the FidelityFX .targets import, which the generator does not parse. FSR headers only: the runtime DLL is Windows-only, so the loader reports FSR unavailable on Android.
